notes: Base layout builder, keyboard controls & 3D optimization
Interactive Base Layout Builder (Base › Layout): custom-place, move and rotate 13 compound structures in 2D and 3D
WASD & Arrow keys smoothly pan the map and 3D camera, Q/E rotate in 3D, +/− zoom, plus a rebindable Keyboard & controls menu in Settings
3D optimization: shared unit geometries/materials and frustum-culled instanced city meshes
